label: ADragon A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back in row-major order
description: The exact original flying dragon: slender long-necked dark forest-green scaled body, small elongated angular reptilian head with narrow toothy muzzle, fine ivory teeth, tiny bright eyes, and the native swept-back ivory horns and gold-green cheek spines. A narrow segmented golden-yellow ventral plate strip runs from throat down the belly. Two short forearms extend forward with small pale hooked claws; two larger bent hind legs hang tucked below the torso. A long tapering green tail sweeps backward with small gold-green dorsal spines and thin gold forked fins near its tip. Two enormous angular bat-like wings rise from the upper back, with long dark green pointed spars and broad triangular pale silvery green membranes, densely mottled olive-gold and gray, shaded almost black on their undersides. Preserve each native wing projection, folded overlap, tapered point and dark underside; do not invent feathers. Keep the native fine dorsal spines, long thin neck, small head, compact torso, tucked legs, long tail and dark shaded scales. No clothing, armor, accessories, riders, added horns, flames, smoke, aura or redesign. Native blue and red variants will be derived offline; preserve clear boundaries between green scales, silvery membranes, gold belly and pale horns.
